deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is March 15, with a later Fall date of August 1.

gre_general.value: GRE General is strongly recommended unless the applicant holds an undergraduate geology degree.
gre_general.quote: Submission of a Graduate Record Examination (GRE) general test score is strongly recommended

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with a bachelor's (90 credits) or with a master's whose credits count toward the 90.
entry_route.quote: Credits earned as part of a Master's degree and through any subsequent graduate work (usually up to a total of 60 credits) may be included in the 90 credits
